Every game in Vault plays in a web browser, with nothing to install and no accounts for students. Here are a few things teachers have told us make a game day go smoothly.

## Before class

<!-- vault:html -->
Open the game yourself first, on the kind of device your students will use. Each game's page says which grades and  
subjects it suits, and links to any curriculum that goes with it.

### The play area

<!-- vault:html -->
Some games need a fairly large window. If a screen is too small, the game's page says so before it starts, and offers  
to try anyway.

<!-- vault:html -->
&#123;{&lt; image src="https://vaultlearninggames.org/sq/img/site/game-bar-4bded0.jpg" alt="The bar above a game in the Vault player" caption="The bar above every game: back to its page, full screen, and help." align="center" &gt;}}

## After class

<!-- vault:html -->
Ask students what they tried that didn't work. In most of these games, a failed attempt is where the learning is.
